evidenceClass: Paired controlled native ARM64 Docker Pi bash tool microbenchmark; synthetic files, no model calls or live accounts.
environment:
Linux aarch64
rtk 0.51.0
git version 2.39.5
v24.21.0
order: Alternating baseline-first/candidate-first paired executions; rotate command order each repetition; same warm WorkspaceSession and image for both.
limitations: Local Docker Desktop with bind-mounted files; no E2B/network latency or production repository workload measured.
Builds and full tests finished before benchmark per coordinating agent; ordinary host/background workloads were not isolated or pinned.
Container startup reported separately and excluded from every tool measurement; existing container is used in both variants.
No live model quality or end-to-end answer latency measurement; lower context can reduce model processing but this benchmark cannot establish that.
